judge: One fresh-context subagent, no model override; no runtime/API model download. Judge model/version/sampling not assumed.
input_allowlist: v2 prompt including its response contract
process: Read only the prepared judge packet and this rubric. Independently solve each query from observed evidence. Do not read evaluation reports, gold, source manifests or previous experiments. Write per-case reasoning and judgment; do not use or import fixed solvers/scorers.

criteria.semantic_correct: True only when the response communicates one clear correct result or appropriate missing-field decision without material falsehood or contradictory alternatives. Explanation or harmless formatting differences alone need not make the semantic result wrong.
criteria.instruction_compliant: Separately assess the requested one-line form and permitted response grammar, including missing-name ordering.
criteria.evidence_grounded: Reject invented/default values, claims that observed fields are absent, and unsupported conclusions.
criteria.ambiguity: Conflicting alternatives or an unclear final decision are ambiguous rather than silently interpreted favorably.
criteria.independent_expected: Derive the correct result/missing decision from the provided evidence and public query only; include derivation in rationale.

reporting: Publish raw judgments and packet/rubric hashes, then map opaque IDs back to original case IDs. Report semantic and strict scores separately, including disagreements. Root may append a reconciliation without overwriting the original judgment.
limitations: One agent on sixteen reused development worlds; a semantic review is not a calibrated external benchmark, independent scientific audit or model-promotion gate.
